_meta.source: CDS C9 (GPA distribution) + C21 (ED/EA) via LLM

schools.notes: C9 mapped from C11 GPA table. Reported all enrolled students only; ranges were 4.0=85.48%, 3.75-3.99=12.50%, 3.50-3.74=1.25%, 3.25-3.49=0.31%, 3.00-3.24=0.16%, 2.50-2.99=0.21%, 2.0-2.49=0.08%. Canonical bins were approximated by combining 4.0 with 3.75-3.99 into 3.75-4.00 and all sub-3.00 ranges into <3.00. C21: the CDS shows no early decision plan and early action is marked no, so ED/EA counts are not reported.

C11 reported all students only. Mapped 4.0 GPA (72.10%) into 3.75-4.00 canonical band, and combined 2.50-2.99 (0.67%), 2.0-2.49 (0.04%), 1.0-1.99 (0.01%), and below 1.0 (0.00%) into <3.00. C21 contains no Fall 2024 ED counts; C22 indicates Early Action exists but the text provides no applicant/admit counts.
